description:
What happens after we die? Twenty-two faiths have answered for thousands of years. Explore every one in 5-minute lessons, then talk to the gods themselves.

App of the Dead turns comparative religion into a game. Bite-size lessons, instant-feedback quizzes, XP, streaks and achievements carry you across 22 belief systems and how each one imagines death, the soul and the world beyond.

MEET THE ORACLE
Converse with deities and guides as on-device AI personas, Anubis, Hermes, Kali, Odin, Azrael and more, and ask them anything about life, death and the afterlife. The Oracle now runs Google Gemma 4, a 2026-generation model, for dramatically smarter, more in-character answers. It runs entirely on your iPhone, so your conversations never leave the device, online or off.

LEARN THROUGH PLAY
Every lesson is a few minutes. Multiple-choice, matching and true-or-false questions give immediate feedback, so the ideas actually stick. Mastery tests crown each path and your streak keeps you coming back.

EVERY BELIEF, SIDE BY SIDE
Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism, Norse, Egyptian, Greek, Zoroastrian and many more, each with its own theme and voice. See where traditions agree, where they diverge, and what they each say lies beyond, all in one place.

START FREE
The complete Judaism path is free forever, no account required. Learn at your own pace, fully offline, with everything stored on your device.

GO PREMIUM
Unlock all 21 remaining paths, unlimited Oracle conversations and every future path with Premium. Try it free for 7 days, then keep learning for one annual price, or go monthly. Prefer to own forever? Unlock a single path on its own, or take Ultimate lifetime access.

BUILT TO KEEP YOU LEARNING
Distinct themes per tradition, full VoiceOver and Dynamic Type support, and a profile that maps your whole journey across all 22 realms.

Death is the one question every culture has tried to answer. Start exploring how.
